info.title: The Drops of God
info.synopsis: Il padre di Shizuku Kanzaki è appena deceduto, lasciando al figlio un curioso testamento che parla della sua grande passione: il vino. Dodici vini vengono nominati in una lista che il padre ha definito "I dodici Apostoli", considerati i migliori del mondo! La prima persona che troverà questi vini erediterà la sua lussuosa enoteca e la sua enorme cantina. La sfida con il fratello adottivo Issei Tomine, grande critico di vini, ha inizio!

episodes.title: The Beginning of All Battles
episodes.synopsis: A beer company employee is caught up in a game of wine after his father's death.

episodes.title: Prayers to a Fragrant Land
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku begins his search for the meaning of the vision he saw.

episodes.title: Thus Spoke the Will
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku begins his search for the first of the Twelve Apostles.

episodes.title: Made by the Hand of Man
episodes.synopsis: The first battle over the Twelve Apostles is held.

episodes.title: The Strange Man From the Wine Division
episodes.synopsis: A strange man transfers to the newly-founded wine division at Taiyo beer.

episodes.title: Bring Back the Smile from That Day
episodes.synopsis: Miyabi is reunited with an old love from school who wants to buy wine from Taiyo beer's wine division.

episodes.title: The Pegasus in the Heavens
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku gets help with Takasugi's challenge from Issei Tomine.

episodes.title: A Smile That`s Mysterious
episodes.synopsis: A mystery author comes to Shizuku about a strange bottle of wine.

episodes.title: A Smile That`s Refreshing and Healing
episodes.synopsis: The identity of the one who sent the threatening letter, as well as the Second Apostle, are revealed.

episodes.title: In the Great Flow of Time
episodes.synopsis: The battle for the Third Apostle begins, and a new member comes to the wine division.

episodes.title: A Large Hand Met in a Nostalgic Place
episodes.synopsis: The battle for the Third Apostle continues.

episodes.title: Take the Distant Path
episodes.synopsis: Louran's jealous rivals plot to separate her from Tomine.

episodes.title: You Remind Me of My First Love
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku and Tomine search for their first loves to win the next Apostle battle.

episodes.title: The Missing Goddesses
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku and Tomine work together to get back stolen wine.

episodes.title: Wine, Served with Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Tomine and Shizuku work together to appraise an old wine collection.

episodes.title: Beautiful Silver Goddess
episodes.synopsis: Tomine and Shizuku climb the Matterhorn in search of the Fifth Apostle.

episodes.title: A Voice, Strict but Gentle
episodes.synopsis: Tomine and Shizuku climb the Matterhorn.

episodes.title: Embraced by the Eternal Universe
episodes.synopsis: The battle for the Sixth Apostle begins.

episodes.title: A Pale Moon Shines in the Distance
episodes.synopsis: Tomine and Shizuku conclude the battle for the Sixth Apostle.

episodes.title: A New Hand, Shrouded in a Veil
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku heads to Australia in search of the Seventh Apostle.

episodes.title: Prayers and Wisdom Unending
episodes.synopsis: The identity of the Seventh Apostle is revealed.

episodes.title: Gentle Fragrance of Distant Days
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku prepares to give up the battle for the Apostles.

episodes.title: Oh, Young One
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku and Tomine try to sniff out counterfeit wine bottles to save a struggling winemaker.

episodes.title: A Light on a Long Road
episodes.synopsis: Shizuku and Tomine race across France to find the Eighth Apostle.

info.title: Detective Conan: The Gold-Star Answer
info.synopsis: I negozi di gioielli in città stanno subendo una serie di rapine, ma la giovane amica di Conan, Ayumi, è entusiasta. I crimini ricordano in modo impressionante gli eventi di un certo anime di magical girl che sta guardando, e lei spera di incontrare una "Pretty Cure!" se i ladri dovessero tornare. Nell'episodio appare Cure Answer, e Conan sembra giustamente sorpreso.

Quando scopre che ad una ragazza a cui è interessato piace Sae, la sua frustrazione sale alle stelle. Tuttavia, in quel momento Akihito si imbatte in Sae che litiga con un altro uomo di fronte ad un hotel e scopre che Sae è omossessuale e passivo.
